notes: Two cleanup passes were needed. The first pass revoked all 11 test gateway keys (POST /key/delete with key_aliases) and then stopped on a 500 from DELETE /api/admin/teams/:id/members/:memberId: that route asks the gateway to delete the same key again, and the already-revoked key makes it throw.

The second pass saw 0 keys left, confirmed the revocation, removed the member rows through the team deletion, deleted both control teams and all four gateway team rows (two duplicate Crew/Night gateway teams had been created for the temporary console managers), and confirmed both manager tokens return HTTP 401.

Because the 500 also skipped credentials.delete and revokeAllForMember for those members, the in-memory tokens stayed until the control service stopped; the API refused them with 401 as soon as the member rows were gone, and the process then stopped with the stack.
